checks.name: empty owned fixture returns complete counts without claiming portability
known structured values complete without reading record contents into report
successful coverage separately reports discovered, started and completed counts
nested extractable and nonextractable keys are counted separately
key metadata is fixed numeric HMAC, secret and sign histograms
arrayBuffer contributes only a type count
typedArray contributes only a type count
date contributes only a type count
map contributes only a type count
set contributes only a type count
blob contributes only a type count
cyclic references terminate without recursion failure
local and session storage use entry counts only
no key operation, cookie read, blob read or web-storage value read occurred
every scan transaction was explicitly readonly
report excludes database/store names, record keys and synthetic private values
report contains only declared schema and numeric count fields
repeated scan preserves progress, type counts and key observations
unsupported values produce inconclusive rather than a portability success
same synthetic key in two records is reported as two observations, not deduplicated identities
owned browser exits and its temporary profile is removed

scope: Exact bundled classifier in an isolated Chrome world with owned synthetic IndexedDB records. All requests locally fulfilled; no real service, account, QR, credentials, browser profile, iOS deployment or device access.
limits: Classifier behavior only. This does not prove iOS behavior, real WhatsApp storage characteristics, session archive completeness or restored authentication.
